items.title: Nully – FOSS AI chat without the bloat
items.raw_excerpt: As someone who doesn't use any of the more "advanced" features on sites like ChatGPT or Claude (agentic mode, memory, image generation, deep research, etc), I found the bloat of these services, both in UX and in performance, to be pretty tedious. There are a million AI chat interfaces out there, but I could never find one that just did simple messaging and history in the most minimal and lightweight way possible. So I made my own. Nully is written in Go and Vanilla HTML/CSS/JS. It literally just sends messages to OpenRouter, receives the result, and stores your messages locally. It's very simple, very clean, and very lightweight (see performance graphs on the site). It has basic chat features, basic model settings, and works with just about any OpenRouter text model. It supports attachment

items.title: Microsoft releases Flint, a visualization language for AI agents
items.raw_excerpt: Data visualizations are the bridge between user and data. But building AI agents that can generate visualizations reliably can be very tricky: - simple chart specs can be reliable, but generated charts are often of low quality due to reliance on system defaults; - complex chart specs with explicit details can produce good-looking charts, but they are verbose and agents can struggle with reliability We figured out it is a limitation on the language issue (not just AI capability thing) -- current visualization languages are a bit too low-level for AI agents, requiring them to explicitly make visual decisions that are supposed to be handled by a good compiler. Flint is a visualization intermediate language to address this issue, allow AI agents to solve this last-mile human-agent interaction

title_i18n.en: Microsoft releases Flint, a visualization language for AI agents
title_i18n.zh: 微软发布 Flint，一种面向 AI 智能体的可视化语言
title_i18n.es: Microsoft lanza Flint, un lenguaje de visualización para agentes de IA

excerpt_i18n.en: Data visualizations are the bridge between user and data. But building AI agents that can generate visualizations reliably can be very tricky: - simple chart specs can be reliable, but generated charts are often of low quality due to reliance on system defaults; - complex chart specs with explicit details can produce good-looking charts, but they are verbose and agents can struggle with reliability We figured out it is a limitation on the language issue (not just AI capability thing) -- current visualization languages are a bit too low-level for AI agents, requiring them to explicitly make visual decisions that are supposed to be handled by a good compiler. Flint is a visualization intermediate language to address this issue, allow AI agents to solve this last-mile human-agent interaction
excerpt_i18n.zh: 数据可视化是用户与数据之间的桥梁。但构建能可靠生成可视化的AI代理可能非常棘手：- 简单的图表规格可以可靠，但生成的图表通常质量较低。
excerpt_i18n.es: Las visualizaciones de datos son el puente entre el usuario y los datos. Pero construir agentes de IA que puedan generar visualizaciones de forma fiable puede ser muy complicado: - las especificaciones de gráficos simples pueden ser fiables, pero los gráficos generados suelen ser de baja calidad.

items.title: Flint: A visualization language for the AI era
items.raw_excerpt: Short chart specifications are easy to write, but often produce uninspiring results. Flint is an open-source visualization language that offers a middle path, letting AI agents create expressive charts from compact, human-editable specifications. The post Flint: A visualization language for the AI era appeared first on Microsoft Research .

title_i18n.en: Flint: A visualization language for the AI era
title_i18n.zh: Flint：人工智能时代的可视化语言
title_i18n.es: Flint: Un lenguaje de visualización para la era de la IA

excerpt_i18n.en: Short chart specifications are easy to write, but often produce uninspiring results. Flint is an open-source visualization language that offers a middle path, letting AI agents create expressive charts from compact, human-editable specifications. The post Flint: A visualization language for the AI era appeared first on Microsoft Research .
excerpt_i18n.zh: 简短的图表规范容易编写，但往往产生平淡的结果。Flint 是一种开源可视化语言，提供了一条中间路径，让 AI 代理能够从紧凑的人类可读规范中创建富有表现力的图表。
excerpt_i18n.es: Las especificaciones cortas de gráficos son fáciles de escribir, pero a menudo producen resultados poco inspiradores. Flint es un lenguaje de visualización de código abierto que ofrece un camino intermedio, permitiendo a los agentes de IA crear gráficos expresivos a partir de especificaciones compactas y legibles por humanos.
